summary: Masonglory Ltd filed Form 6-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq notification that it regained compliance with the minimum bid price requirement (Rule 5550(a)(2)). The company had received a deficiency notice on March 13, 2026, and effected a share consolidation and reclassification into Class A and Class B shares on August 11, 2026. Nasdaq confirmed the closing bid price was at or above US$1.00 for 10 consecutive business days through August 24, 2026. No special situation—this is a routine regulatory compliance update regarding continued listing status.
